## Summary

```diff
 dtplyr generated Margin-label expressions
- as.character / rep / length / sum resolved in caller root
+ base-qualified generated helpers
```

Preserve source keys, requested Margin labels and explicit observed-collision refusal across all four Margin verbs. Caller-written expressions retain ordinary lexical lookup.

Closes #1143.

## Evidence

- **Before (`7f0aecaf` + initial regression):** Both nesting verbs returned MASK after late as.character rebinding. The pre-fix collision regression also reproduced all eight helper/verb bypasses.
  **After (`e02394cf`):** Full Review-ready passed, including all 202 test files and snapshots, source-tarball check, examples, vignettes and manual; 0 ERROR/WARNING/NOTE. Public regressions cover typed-missing/empty controls, source immutability, user lookup and collection boundaries.
- Verification: https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1168#issuecomment-6600108878
- Review: https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1168#issuecomment-6600122415 (Standards 0 findings; Spec 0 findings).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Generated call changes and tests can be reverted.

**Blast Radius:** dtplyr

Shared Margin-label construction and collision checks; other backends retain their existing helper spellings.
